title: TRIDENT: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Finance, Medicine, and Law
reasoning: The core contribution of this paper is the Trident-Bench, which evaluates Large Language Models (LLMs) specifically on their adherence to professional ethical codes (AMA Principles of Medical Ethics, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct, and CFA Institute Code of Ethics). The evaluation framework and datasets are entirely built upon benchmarking these ethical standards.
